high_level_description: The image depicts a woman walking outdoors on what appears to be a city street. She is dressed in a stylish outfit consisting of a white button-up shirt with short sleeves, a gray pleated mini skirt, and black lace-up boots. Her long dark hair is straight and falls over her shoulders. She accessorizes with a choker necklace and a bracelet on her left wrist. In the background, there are several other individuals. One person, partially visible, is wearing a black shirt and jeans, holding a green can in their right hand.
